d:
A humanoid demonic entity with pale ash-grey skin and a muscular, towering build. The face is skeletal with a wide, gaping maw and glowing amber eyes. A pair of massive, tattered charcoal-black leathery wings extend from the back, and a thick, spiked obsidian-black tail curls around the legs. The hands end in four sharp obsidian-black claws.
BODY COLOR: ash-grey
